summary: The rendering update leaves the reviewed intake unchanged. All 108 handoff digests match, and the update adds no security finding.
evidence: Role-start HEAD and the final recheck returned b87ee87d4c8086224df45d714459fc7723536f6b. The phase baseline and prior passing review commit are ancestors.
test-strategy.md:91–97 and 173 apply Review B to the Phase 2 intake. The full phase diff includes prepare.mjs. The delta since d398c235 leaves the scripts and ignore rules unchanged.
The delta changes actor sizing and shot duration. actorBoxes.ts:63–93 calculates geometry, and Song.tsx:98–116 changes the shot window. The existing asset lookup at Actors.tsx:73 is unchanged.
The rendering delta adds no path construction, filesystem access, symlink handling, authentication, or secret access. The new evidence script uses fixed weeks and media paths.
The independent handoff check verified 108 of 108 SHA-256 values and all four scene pairs. It found no symlink on any checked source path.
The handoff has 110 files. The manifest SHA-256 is f16560ba35c86b0f8e63140fbda9235ae32ea176af8240e05b5b3aea5513b759. It matches the prior review and Green's before-and-after record.
The Git index and the content/ status were empty. No commit since the prior review touched content/, an intake script, a credential file, a song video, or a poster.
The history scan found zero Thai characters in all versions of 23 changed text paths. It found no common credential token or private key marker. All six changed binary paths are frame JPEGs.
The text scan found zero Thai characters in seven generated specs and five handoff text files. It did not inspect image pixels or audio.
Git ignore covers all 24 Phase 2 delivery files. The eight w04 and w07 outputs are regular, untracked files. Their SHA-256 values match the committed render evidence.
Committed test output records P2-B1, P2-B2 and P2-B5 passing and 81 project tests passing. This audit did not rerun project tests.
B9 and B10 remain prior tech debt in unchanged intake code. The brief contained no CONTEST items. No new finding requires a fix.
A2 does not apply because the change has no publish transition. A6 does not apply because the registry makes no claim that an intake security state is resolved.
The existing unstaged render.mjs edit remains outside the audited commit. This audit did not edit it.
